 Welcome to SKCET 
 Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology is the most sought after Institution among the premier technical Institutions in South India. Since its establishment in the year 1998, the Institution has marched towards the pinnacle of glory through its remarkable achievements in the field of Engineering Education. It is an Autonomous Institution, Affiliated to Anna University with 7 programmes being accredited by NBA and it offers 11 UG programmes, 4 PG programmes, 1 integrated programme and 8 research programmes. The Institution offers an exciting academic environment with well qualified dedicated faculty members to inspire and nurture the student fraternity. With industry drafted Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) curriculum and syllabi, the Institution takes every effort to bring its students to the forefront of the society as skillful and responsible engineers.

 Institution 
 Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology continues to leave behind its indelible footprints on young lives that pass through its portals every year. SKCET is a premier Autonomous Institution that offers experiential education through learning, discovery, and innovation for all scholars, ever since inception.
 Transformative Education 
 SKCET is one of the pioneer Institutions to jointly offer an exclusive B.Tech Degree program in Computer Science and Business Systems
 in partnership with Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. SKCET launched an exclusive M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (5 Year Integrated) Degree program in Full Stack Engineering powered by Virtusa Corporation.
 Nurturing Innovation 
 The Institution is actively involved in collaborative funded research projects with Government agencies to a tune of 10.39 crores.
 It has published 357 patents and 27 patents grants to date. The faculty and students have published 1321 research papers in refereed journals for the last two academic years. The Institution is also accredited by DSIR with SIRO recognition to further facilitate research and development.
 Extensive Collabration 
 SKCET has been selected as the nodal center for MHRD Innovation Cell. Aiming at fruitful outcomes
 such as technical support, training, industrial exposure, internships, and placements, SKCET has signed 71 MoUs and 14 Centres of Excellence with leading Industries and premier Institutions like NITTTR, Chandigarh, Tata Consultancy Services, Virtusa Corp, Valparaiso University, Seine Aerospace – Dubai, Barry Wehmiller, Sector Skill Council, to name a few.
 Vision 
 To Produce Globally Competitive Engineers with High Ethical Values and Social Responsibilities.
 Mission 
 To impart the highest quality state-of-the-art technical education by providing impetus to innovation, research, and development and empowering students with entrepreneurship skills.

Institution

Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology continues to leave behind its indelible footprints on young lives that pass through its portals every year. SKCET is a premier Autonomous Institution that offers experiential education through learning, discovery, and innovation for all scholars, ever since inception.

Transformative Education

SKCET is one of the pioneer Institutions to jointly offer an exclusive B.Tech Degree program in Computer Science and Business Systems

in partnership with Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. SKCET launched an exclusive M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (5 Year Integrated) Degree program in Full Stack Engineering powered by Virtusa Corporation.

Nurturing Innovation

The Institution is actively involved in collaborative funded research projects with Government agencies to a tune of 10.39 crores.

It has published 357 patents and 27 patents grants to date. The faculty and students have published 1321 research papers in refereed journals for the last two academic years. The Institution is also accredited by DSIR with SIRO recognition to further facilitate research and development.

Extensive Collabration

SKCET has been selected as the nodal center for MHRD Innovation Cell. Aiming at fruitful outcomes

such as technical support, training, industrial exposure, internships, and placements, SKCET has signed 71 MoUs and 14 Centres of Excellence with leading Industries and premier Institutions like NITTTR, Chandigarh, Tata Consultancy Services, Virtusa Corp, Valparaiso University, Seine Aerospace – Dubai, Barry Wehmiller, Sector Skill Council, to name a few.

Vision

To Produce Globally Competitive Engineers with High Ethical Values and Social Responsibilities.

Mission

  • To impart the highest quality state-of-the-art technical education by providing impetus to innovation, research, and development and empowering students with entrepreneurship skills.
  • To instill ethical values, imbibe a sense of social responsibility, and strive for societal well-being.
  • To identify the needs of society and offer sustainable solutions through outreach programs.

Quality Policy

We are committed to produce globally competitive and ethical engineers through the following

  • Innovative Teaching Learning Process
  • Accelerated Research
  • Industry Based Curriculum
  • Practicing Moral and Ethical Values
  • Continuous Process Improvement

The Knowledge Hub

SKCET excels in its various efforts towards the achievement of academic goals. It is one of the 28 prestigious nodal centers across India chosen by MoE to host the ‘Smart India Hackathon’ for three consecutive times. 8 teams from SKCET have won First prize and 1 Special prize in Smart India Hackathon 2022 (Software and Hardware Edition). Our students have secured internships from Google, JP Morgan, Microsoft, etc. Our Institution is at 23rd in the National level and Second rank in the state level and 1st in the Coimbatore region in the NPTEL certifications ranking during Jan – April 2023 which reveals the academic excellence of its students.

A Pioneer

SKCET has been identified to mentor 10 non – accredited Institutions in our geographic vicinity to support its goal of accrediting all colleges in India by 2022. The Institution has secured 73rd position in MoE- NIRF Ranking 2022 . SKCET has been chosen as the nodal centre by IIT Bombay for spoken tutorial project of MoE and one among 8 partner Institutions of AICTE across the Nation for FDP programs.

Illuminating Careers

The Institution also has an exemplary record of Students Placements. The Training & Placement cell of SKCET plays a pivotal role in counselling and guiding the students for successful placements from top notch Companies. In 2023, as a result of customized training based on the career choice of students, 974 students were able to get 1452 job offers in 282 companies including Multinational Core and IT Product based companies with 46 LPA as the highest package with Average Package of 6 LPA.

 Management 
 Smt. S. Malarvizhi 
 Chairperson and Managing Trustee 
 Smt. S. Malarvizhi, is a visionary academician, a reformer, and an able administrator. As an educator herself, she firmly believes in education that nurtures holistic development for students. She is the driving force behind the Sri Krishna Institutions to have emerged as one of the pioneers in providing quality education.
 The Institutions offer education to over 23,000 students through two Engineering Colleges, two Arts and Science Colleges, and a Polytechnic College. Under her aegis, the colleges have been highly ranked by the NIRF. The exceptional architecture and beautiful green ambiance of the campuses have been recognized by AICTE as the best institutions in maintaining a Clean and Green Campus under the Swacchta ranking 2019.
 Smt.S. Malarvizhi holds key positions in various industries and educational and professional bodies. She is currently serving as a Member of the Syndicate of Anna University.
She is the Vice President of the Educational Promotional Society of India. She serves as a joint chairperson of the National Educational Conclave, CII Coimbatore and Vice Chairperson of Tamilnadu Athletic Association.
 Her vast knowledge, multi-dimensional approach, and futuristic vision propel the institutions to excel in academics and co-curricular aspects year by year. She emphasizes on providing global exposure to students through a leading-edge curriculum. She strongly believes that proper education is a launch pad for success. She strives to offer education that grooms students as innovators, leaders, and true team players. She instills values and treads with her students in building a strong platform for a beautiful future together.
 Besides her dynamic role in education, Smt.S. Malarvizhi has been actively involved in rendering laudable service to society through the promotion of human welfare as a social reformer and a passionate philanthropist.
 Smt. S. Malarvizhi with her magnificent vision, adroitness, and ever-enthusiastic positive vibes has inspired many young minds to reach heights. Her enthusiasm is very infectious and her radiating smile says it all…
 Sri. K. Adithya 
 Trustee 
 Mr. K. Adithya, BE (Mechanical Engineering) and Master of Business, Australia, is a passionate entrepreneur. Through his education and varied cultural exposure, he has acquired the knowledge and skills necessary for his diverse career.
 Mr. K. Adithya is establishing his path in the industrial and business world. His passion and commitment are visible through his achievements in manufacturing and exporting of machinery, his ventures in managing Educational Institutions, IT and ITES businesses, and the distribution of international products. He holds the position of managing partner in multiple companies.
 In addition to his professional contributions, Mr. K. Adithya is deeply involved in the field of education. He holds the roles of trustee and secretary at both Sri Krishna Trust and VLB Trust, where he oversees the education of a substantial student body, with over 25,000 students benefiting from these institutions annually. His commitment to education extends globally, with his companies offering top-tier solutions in Engineering, Information Technology, and Higher Education, ensuring a competitive edge on the international stage.
 Beyond his professional life, he is an avid fitness enthusiast, likes to play football, tennis, biking and swimming. Additionally, he has a penchant for watches.
 Dr. K. Sundararaman 
 CEO 
 Dr. K. Sundararaman, Chief Executive Officer of Sri Krishna Institutions (SKI), based in Coimbatore city, embarked on his professional career as an academician and has four decades of proficient experience in various institutions.

 Ethics and Integrity

 Team Spirit

 Principal’s Message 
 Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology (SKCET) is bounded in illuminating the minds of the students through diverse learning platforms to enter the professional world. Endowed with a futuristic outlook, SKCET is committed to consistently enhance the quality of all academic activities, striving to fully meet the expectations of students, parents and society at large. We aim to nurture a culture of curiosity, critical thinking and ethical responsibility, empowering our students to become future leaders and change-makers.
 I am confident that by leveraging our strengths, embracing innovation and fostering a spirit of collaboration, we will make significant progress in advancing our mission and achieve excellence in all areas.
 I firmly believe that through harnessing our collective strengths and embracing innovation, we can propel SKCET to greater heights.
 I look forward to working together with the SKCET family to cultivate a vibrant and inclusive academic experience. My vision is to establish a robust organizational framework, foster a dedicated teaching-learning environment and promote a culture of impactful research.
After twenty-five years of academic excellence, we are poised to transition from being very good to great. Let us gear up to embark on our journey towards the next milestone, elevating our growth trajectory and strive to achieve greatness.
 Thank you for your unwavering commitment and dedication. Together, let us steer SKCET towards a future brimming with boundless possibilities.
 As we move forward, our mission remains clear: to empower future leaders with innovative problem-solving skills, catalyzing sustainable societal progress. I invite all stakeholders to join us in shaping a brighter future together.

 Proud Host of Smart India Hackathon 2024 for the 5th time.

 77 th  Rank in Engineering Category (2023), 101-125 Band in Management, 101 – 150 Band in Overall Ranking  in NIRF 2023. 
 11 th Rank in ARIIA RANKING.

 4 th  Rank in TamilNadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA).

 The Most Engaged Institutions of the Year 2023 at ICT BRIDGE 2023.
 Appreciated by Infosys Springboard Team for being  Number 1 in Tamil Nadu  in terms of maximum certification done in niche skills line cyber security, AI, IoT.

 Conferred 23 rd Rank at National Level, 2 nd Rank at State Level and 1 st Rank at District Level in NPTEL Exams during Jan – Apr 2023.
 Recognized with SIRO by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).

 10 first year students along with a faculty member had the honor of attending the Foundation Day Celebration of Various States and Union Territories at Raj Bhavan, Chennai.

 Achieved All-India 4 th rank in ARIIA Ranking.
 Proud recipient of Academic Partner Excellence Awards 2022 , for training Highest Number of Students through ICT Academy.
 Certificate of Appreciation by Bhumi Campus Awards 2022 , for our efforts towards developing Unique Social Initiatives Bhumi.
 Awarded as Winner in AICTE-Lilavati Award 2021-22 , by the Ministry of Education (MoE) under the sub-category ‘Technology for Women’. Also secured the 2nd runner-up prize in the prestigious AICTE- Lilavati award 2020-21, by the Ministry of Education (MoE) under the sub-category ‘Sanitation and Hygiene’.
 Awarded with the Academic Partner Excellence Awards-2022 in recognition and appreciation for training the highest number of students through ICT Academy students self-learning programs during the period April 2020 to March 2022 at ICT BRIDGE 2022.
 SKCET is bestowed with the  INDIA STEM AWARD 2022 by the All India Council for Robotics & Automation(AICRA).

 SKCET is also awarded with the  ‘Best Spoke Institution for IEDP Promotional activities’ under PMO-IEDP for the academic year 2021-22.
 Awarded with the  Academic Partner Excellence Awards-2022 in recognition and appreciation for training the highest number of students through ICT Academy students self-learning programs during the period April 2020 to March 2022 at ICT BRIDGE 2022.

 Achieved All-India 2 nd rank in ARIIA Ranking 2020.
 Recognized as the Top 5 th Private Engineering College with best value for money in India Today MRDA Rankings 2021.

 Conferred with National Third Rank in Utkrisht Sansthan Vishwakarma Award (USVA) 2019. Secured the 2 nd runner-up prize in the prestigious AICTE- Lilavati award, under the Ministry of Education (MoE) for the sub-category Sanitation and Hygiene.
 Proud recipient of Learnathon Awards 2020 , for training our students in Industry 4.0 courses by ICT Academy.

 SKCET received “Best Campus Partner college 2021” from Kovai.co for the stellar performance of SKCET students.
 Chosen as a prestigious nodal center to host the software edition of Toycathon 2021 -Virtual Mode.
 The UG Programmes – Civil Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering and Mechanical Engineering are awarded with Accreditation status by NBA for a period of Three years.
 SKCET has been proudly awarded with III prize in AICTE- Utkrisht Sansthan Vishwakarma Award (USVA) at National level and First prize in Tamil Nadu region for enhancing the income of Villages through intervention of Technology/Management practices.

 Institution with the highest Industry Institute Interaction 2020, vanquishing 232 participating Institutions
 National Cloud Champion –Institution Award, amongst 500+ Members Institutions
 National Cloud Champion – Coordinator Award

 Successfully obtained the Extension of Autonomous STATUS for 5 Years.
 Offering exclusive B.E degree program in Computer Science and Business Systems in partnership with TCS Ltd. 
 Offering exclusive M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (5 year Integrated) degree program Powered by Virtusa Corporation .
 Conferred with Second National Rank in SWACHH Campus Rankings 2019 , consecutively for the second year amongst the Higher Educational Institutions in the country by Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India.
 Ranked second in the Clean & Smart Campus: 2019 awards instituted by Swachh Bharat Mission Council.
 “National Third Rank” for the One Student-One Tree Initiative in Jal Shakti Abhiyan for the exemplary green cover ventures initiated with Mega Plantation of 10,050 trees at SKCET campus.
 Significant contributor for Jal Shakthi Abiyan 
 Ranked 97 th in NIRF Ranking 2019 – Engineering Category.
 One among the Top 100 Institutions across India in ARIIA Ranking 2019 .
 Chosen as one of the 28 prestigious nodal centers for the third consecutive year to host the software edition of Smart India Hackathon 2019. 
 Conferred 22 nd Rank at National Level and 3 rd Rank in Coimbatore zone in NPTEL Exams during Nov / Dec 2019
 Received Academic Partner Excellence Award 2019 from ICT Academy 
 ‘Distinctive Citation’ for the category ‘Research and Innovation in Higher Education’ ‘Torchbearer’ in ‘Higher Education Category’ from India Didac Association partnered with MSDE, MIET, AICTE, Digital India, Skill India and UNESCO.
 Received ‘Partnership Renewable Certificate’ by Virtusa Corp.
 One among 8 partner institutes of AICTE across the Nation for FDP programs.
 Selected as nodal center for MHRD INNOVATION CELL. 
 Identified to mentor 10 non-accredited Institutions in our geographic vicinity and support them for getting NAAC accreditation
 The institution is one among 800 institutions selected by Ministry of Human Resource Development for Establishing the Institution Innovation Council (IIC) to promote the culture of research among students. 
 Kovai Vizha Best Innovation Award bagged by SAR – SKCET Club.
 Significant laurels in Hack Harvard 2019 (Harvard University, USA), Hack & Roll 2020 (NTU, Singapore), TCS Connect 2019 – XR Hackathon,TN Police Hackathon, Cameron Innovay and Indian Karting Race
 For the outstanding and exemplary contribution towards Education, Skill Development and Research, SKCET has been awarded with, “Best Engineering College in Tamil Nadu” for the Year 2019.
 Acquired 2 nd Rank in National Level SWACHH Campus.

 CSR 
 Ethical & Sustainable Engagement at SKCET 
 SKCET committed to operate in an ethical and sustainable manner while considering the impact of their activities on society and the environment. Our students actively participate in various social activities regularly to operate in an economically, socially, and environmentally sustainable manner while balancing the interests of various stakeholders. These activities instill ethical values, imbibe a sense of social responsibility, and strive for the societal well-being of the students.
 SKCET UYIR Club has bagged the “Best Volunteering College award”. Sri.V.Balakrishnan, Commissioner of Police, Coimbatore city presented the award and appreciation certificates to the volunteers on 10.01.2024 at Commissioner of police office.
 UYIR Club of SKCET has conducted drawing competition to the students of Government girls higher secondary school, Thondamuthur on the theme “Road safety” on 07.12.2023. Students showcased their talents and best drawings were awarded prizes.
 National service scheme of SKCET has celebrated International Yoga Day at the campus on 21st June 2023. Students were given an insight on the importance of yoga in our daily life by Ms.Sripriya, Yoga Trainer, Coimbatore.
 National service scheme of SKCET whole heartedly embraced the significance of celebrating Yoga by organizing an exclusive session for the faculty members to raise awareness about the numerous benefits of Yoga and its positive impact.
 UYIR Club Volunteers of SKCET along with Coimbatore City Police participated in the diwali traffic regulation at big bazaar street from 03.11.2023 to 10.11.2023. The volunteers educated the public by giving short messages on the benefits of wearing helmets ,seat belts and obeying traffic rules.
 Kovai fiesta 2023 is ideated, planned, and executed by the SKCET NSS Volunteers. The objective of this event is to provide a dynamic learning platform on marketing skills to students and cater an unforgettable shopping experience to its audience.
 National service scheme of SKCET has organized Medical camp at Attapadi Village, Coimbatore. Basic medical examinations were conducted to the beneficiaries at the venue.
 A rally on “Awareness about fitness “was organized by National service scheme of SKCET. NSS Volunteers inspired the public people by giving valuable messages about the importance of fitness in daily life
 SKCET has been awarded certificate of appreciation for taking part in “Drug free kovai” campaign organized by Coimbatore city police and park institutions.

National service scheme of SKCET has celebrated International Yoga Day at the campus on 21st June 2023. Students were given an insight on the importance of yoga in our daily life by Ms.Sripriya, Yoga Trainer, Coimbatore.

National service scheme of SKCET whole heartedly embraced the significance of celebrating Yoga by organizing an exclusive session for the faculty members to raise awareness about the numerous benefits of Yoga and its positive impact.

UYIR Club Volunteers of SKCET along with Coimbatore City Police participated in the diwali traffic regulation at big bazaar street from 03.11.2023 to 10.11.2023. The volunteers educated the public by giving short messages on the benefits of wearing helmets ,seat belts and obeying traffic rules.

Kovai fiesta 2023 is ideated, planned, and executed by the SKCET NSS Volunteers. The objective of this event is to provide a dynamic learning platform on marketing skills to students and cater an unforgettable shopping experience to its audience.

National service scheme of SKCET has organized Medical camp at Attapadi Village, Coimbatore. Basic medical examinations were conducted to the beneficiaries at the venue.

A rally on “Awareness about fitness “was organized by National service scheme of SKCET. NSS Volunteers inspired the public people by giving valuable messages about the importance of fitness in daily life

SKCET has been awarded certificate of appreciation for taking part in “Drug free kovai” campaign organized by Coimbatore city police and park institutions.

 About IQAC 
 About IQAC 
 The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology (SKCET) was established in the year 2015. The IQAC cell at SKCET plays a pivotal role in ensuring a culture of excellence by implementing a robust quality assurance framework. The IQAC cell actively engages in promoting a culture of continuous improvement in all aspects of the Institution’s functioning. The IQAC cell also plays a crucial role in upholding the college’s accreditation status and ensuring adherence to both national and international quality standards.
 By employing a comprehensive feedback mechanism. It also ensures that the suggestions and concerns of students, staff, and stakeholders are addressed with utmost efficacy. Through its dynamic initiatives, the IQAC at SKCET cultivates an environment of excellence and innovation in education. Through its dynamic initiatives, the IQAC cell cultivates an environment of excellence and innovation in education, contributing significantly to the institution’s overall growth and reputation.
 Objectives of IQAC 
 To promote quality enhancement through internalization of quality culture and institutionalization of best practices for effective functioning of the Institution.
 To build and uphold a well-structured framework for continuous improvement and quality monitoring of the institution.
 To establish and maintain a comprehensive system for documentation and reporting, to monitor performance metrics and generate detailed reports.
 Best Practices of IQAC

About IQAC

About IQAC

The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology (SKCET) was established in the year 2015. The IQAC cell at SKCET plays a pivotal role in ensuring a culture of excellence by implementing a robust quality assurance framework. The IQAC cell actively engages in promoting a culture of continuous improvement in all aspects of the Institution’s functioning. The IQAC cell also plays a crucial role in upholding the college’s accreditation status and ensuring adherence to both national and international quality standards.

By employing a comprehensive feedback mechanism. It also ensures that the suggestions and concerns of students, staff, and stakeholders are addressed with utmost efficacy. Through its dynamic initiatives, the IQAC at SKCET cultivates an environment of excellence and innovation in education. Through its dynamic initiatives, the IQAC cell cultivates an environment of excellence and innovation in education, contributing significantly to the institution’s overall growth and reputation.

Objectives of IQAC

  • To promote quality enhancement through internalization of quality culture and institutionalization of best practices for effective functioning of the Institution.
  • To build and uphold a well-structured framework for continuous improvement and quality monitoring of the institution.
  • To establish and maintain a comprehensive system for documentation and reporting, to monitor performance metrics and generate detailed reports.

Best Practices of IQAC

Outcome Based Education

Outcome-Based Education (OBE) focuses on measuring student performance through specific predefined outcomes. It ensures that all educational activities are aligned with achieving these outcomes, promoting a clear, goal- oriented approach to teaching and learning.

  • IQAC helps establish clear program outcomes, course outcomes and learning objectives.
  • IQAC facilitates continuous improvement of OBE processes and practices.
  • IQAC ensures student involvement in OBE processes through feedback and assessment.
  • IQAC fosters industry connections to ensure OBE aligns with industry needs.

Blended Learning

A combination of traditional face-to-face classroom instruction with online educational materials and interactive opportunities that allows greater flexibility and personalized learning experiences for students.

Industry-Academia Collaborations

IQAC ensures the partnerships bridge the gap between academic theory and practical industry application. These collaborations provide students with real- world exposure through internships, projects, and guest lectures from industry professionals. The Institution follows a Consistent Industry-based curriculum redesign process, establishes Centres of Excellence and Memorandums of Understanding with prominent Industries and encourages students and faculty members to take up professional courses in Industries

Feedback Systems

IQAC monitors Effective feedback systems that involve regular and constructive assessments of student performance to identify areas of improvement and reinforce positive learning behaviors contributing to continuous academic development.

Mentor-Mentee System

The effective mentor-mentee system pairs experienced mentors with students to provide guidance, support and knowledge sharing enabling personal and professional growth of students and helping mentees steer through the academic challenges.

Systematic documentation within the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) entails the meticulous recording and preservation of data pertaining to quality assurance and enhancement initiatives. This encompasses the documentation of institutional policies, academic and administrative audits, stakeholder feedback, and the formulation and execution of action plans, thereby ensuring ongoing quality improvement and adherence to accreditation standards.

In the Institutional level, IQAC maintains and updates Policy documents, compiles and publishes annual reports highlighting Institutional achievements and progress, Prepares and submits documents for accreditation and certification purposes.

In the department level, IQAC helps department develop and update handbooks outlining processes, ensures departments maintain up-to-date course files, including syllabi, lesson plans and assessment records, assists departments in showcasing their documents helps department maintain accurate records and data on student learning outcomes, faculty achievements and research activities.

By facilitating systematic documentation, IQAC ensures

  • Transparency and accountability
  • Data-driven decision-making
  • Compliance with accreditation and regulatory requirements
  • Improved institutional and departmental performance
  • Enhanced quality and excellence in education.

 Institution 
 Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology continues to leave behind its indelible footprints on young lives that pass through its portals every year. SKCET is a premier Autonomous Institution that offers experiential education through learning, discovery, and innovation for all scholars, ever since inception.
 Transformative Education 
 SKCET is one of the pioneer Institutions to jointly offer an exclusive B.Tech Degree program in Computer Science and Business Systems
 in partnership with Tata Consultancy Services Ltd. SKCET launched an exclusive M.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (5 Year Integrated) Degree program in Full Stack Engineering powered by Virtusa Corporation.
 Nurturing Innovation 
 The Institution is actively involved in collaborative funded research projects with Government agencies to a tune of 10.39 crores.
 It has published 357 patents and 27 patents grants to date. The faculty and students have published 1321 research papers in refereed journals for the last two academic years. The Institution is also accredited by DSIR with SIRO recognition to further facilitate research and development.
 Extensive Collabration 
 SKCET has been selected as the nodal center for MHRD Innovation Cell. Aiming at fruitful outcomes
 such as technical support, training, industrial exposure, internships, and placements, SKCET has signed 71 MoUs and 14 Centres of Excellence with leading Industries and premier Institutions like NITTTR, Chandigarh, Tata Consultancy Services, Virtusa Corp, Valparaiso University, Seine Aerospace – Dubai, Barry Wehmiller, Sector Skill Council, to name a few.
 Vision 
 To Produce Globally Competitive Engineers with High Ethical Values and Social Responsibilities.
 Mission 
 To impart the highest quality state-of-the-art technical education by providing impetus to innovation, research, and development and empowering students with entrepreneurship skills.
 To instill ethical values, imbibe a sense of social responsibility, and strive for societal well-being.
 To identify the needs of society and offer sustainable solutions through outreach programs.
 Quality Policy 
 We are committed to produce globally competitive and ethical engineers through the following
 Innovative Teaching Learning Process Accelerated Research Industry Based Curriculum Practicing Moral and Ethical Values Continuous Process Improvement 
 The Knowledge Hub 
 SKCET excels in its various efforts towards the achievement of academic goals. It is one of the 28 prestigious nodal centers across India chosen by MoE to host the ‘Smart India Hackathon’ for three consecutive times. 8 teams from SKCET have won First prize and 1 Special prize in Smart India Hackathon 2022 (Software and Hardware Edition). Our students have secured internships from Google, JP Morgan, Microsoft, etc. Our Institution is at 23rd in the National level and Second rank in the state level and 1st in the Coimbatore region in the NPTEL certifications ranking during Jan – April 2023 which reveals the academic excellence of its students.
 A Pioneer 
 SKCET has been identified to mentor 10 non – accredited Institutions in our geographic vicinity to support its goal of accrediting all colleges in India by 2022. The Institution has secured 73rd position in MoE- NIRF Ranking 2022 . SKCET has been chosen as the nodal centre by IIT Bombay for spoken tutorial project of MoE and one among 8 partner Institutions of AICTE across the Nation for FDP programs.
 Illuminating Careers 
 The Institution also has an exemplary record of Students Placements. The Training & Placement cell of SKCET plays a pivotal role in counselling and guiding the students for successful placements from top notch Companies. In 2023, as a result of customized training based on the career choice of students, 974 students were able to get 1452 job offers in 282 companies including Multinational Core and IT Product based companies with 46 LPA as the highest package with Average Package of 6 LPA.

 Management 
 Smt. S. Malarvizhi 
 Chairperson and Managing Trustee 
 Smt. S. Malarvizhi, is a visionary academician, a reformer, and an able administrator. As an educator herself, she firmly believes in education that nurtures holistic development for students. She is the driving force behind the Sri Krishna Institutions to have emerged as one of the pioneers in providing quality education.
 The Institutions offer education to over 23,000 students through two Engineering Colleges, two Arts and Science Colleges, and a Polytechnic College. Under her aegis, the colleges have been highly ranked by the NIRF. The exceptional architecture and beautiful green ambiance of the campuses have been recognized by AICTE as the best institutions in maintaining a Clean and Green Campus under the Swacchta ranking 2019.
 Smt.S. Malarvizhi holds key positions in various industries and educational and professional bodies. She is currently serving as a Member of the Syndicate of Anna University.
She is the Vice President of the Educational Promotional Society of India. She serves as a joint chairperson of the National Educational Conclave, CII Coimbatore and Vice Chairperson of Tamilnadu Athletic Association.
 Her vast knowledge, multi-dimensional approach, and futuristic vision propel the institutions to excel in academics and co-curricular aspects year by year. She emphasizes on providing global exposure to students through a leading-edge curriculum. She strongly believes that proper education is a launch pad for success. She strives to offer education that grooms students as innovators, leaders, and true team players. She instills values and treads with her students in building a strong platform for a beautiful future together.
 Besides her dynamic role in education, Smt.S. Malarvizhi has been actively involved in rendering laudable service to society through the promotion of human welfare as a social reformer and a passionate philanthropist.
 Smt. S. Malarvizhi with her magnificent vision, adroitness, and ever-enthusiastic positive vibes has inspired many young minds to reach heights. Her enthusiasm is very infectious and her radiating smile says it all…
 Sri. K. Adithya 
 Trustee 
 Mr. K. Adithya, BE (Mechanical Engineering) and Master of Business, Australia, is a passionate entrepreneur. Through his education and varied cultural exposure, he has acquired the knowledge and skills necessary for his diverse career.
 Mr. K. Adithya is establishing his path in the industrial and business world. His passion and commitment are visible through his achievements in manufacturing and exporting of machinery, his ventures in managing Educational Institutions, IT and ITES businesses, and the distribution of international products. He holds the position of managing partner in multiple companies.
 In addition to his professional contributions, Mr. K. Adithya is deeply involved in the field of education. He holds the roles of trustee and secretary at both Sri Krishna Trust and VLB Trust, where he oversees the education of a substantial student body, with over 25,000 students benefiting from these institutions annually. His commitment to education extends globally, with his companies offering top-tier solutions in Engineering, Information Technology, and Higher Education, ensuring a competitive edge on the international stage.
 Beyond his professional life, he is an avid fitness enthusiast, likes to play football, tennis, biking and swimming. Additionally, he has a penchant for watches.

 Principal’s Message 
 Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology (SKCET) is bounded in illuminating the minds of the students through diverse learning platforms to enter the professional world. Endowed with a futuristic outlook, SKCET is committed to consistently enhance the quality of all academic activities, striving to fully meet the expectations of students, parents and society at large. We aim to nurture a culture of curiosity, critical thinking and ethical responsibility, empowering our students to become future leaders and change-makers.
 I am confident that by leveraging our strengths, embracing innovation and fostering a spirit of collaboration, we will make significant progress in advancing our mission and achieve excellence in all areas.
 I firmly believe that through harnessing our collective strengths and embracing innovation, we can propel SKCET to greater heights.
 I look forward to working together with the SKCET family to cultivate a vibrant and inclusive academic experience. My vision is to establish a robust organizational framework, foster a dedicated teaching-learning environment and promote a culture of impactful research.
After twenty-five years of academic excellence, we are poised to transition from being very good to great. Let us gear up to embark on our journey towards the next milestone, elevating our growth trajectory and strive to achieve greatness.
 Thank you for your unwavering commitment and dedication. Together, let us steer SKCET towards a future brimming with boundless possibilities.
 As we move forward, our mission remains clear: to empower future leaders with innovative problem-solving skills, catalyzing sustainable societal progress. I invite all stakeholders to join us in shaping a brighter future together.

 Ethical & Sustainable Engagement at SKCET 
 SKCET committed to operate in an ethical and sustainable manner while considering the impact of their activities on society and the environment. Our students actively participate in various social activities regularly to operate in an economically, socially, and environmentally sustainable manner while balancing the interests of various stakeholders. These activities instill ethical values, imbibe a sense of social responsibility, and strive for the societal well-being of the students.
 SKCET UYIR Club has bagged the “Best Volunteering College award”. Sri.V.Balakrishnan, Commissioner of Police, Coimbatore city presented the award and appreciation certificates to the volunteers on 10.01.2024 at Commissioner of police office.
 UYIR Club of SKCET has conducted drawing competition to the students of Government girls higher secondary school, Thondamuthur on the theme “Road safety” on 07.12.2023. Students showcased their talents and best drawings were awarded prizes.
 National service scheme of SKCET has celebrated International Yoga Day at the campus on 21st June 2023. Students were given an insight on the importance of yoga in our daily life by Ms.Sripriya, Yoga Trainer, Coimbatore.
 National service scheme of SKCET whole heartedly embraced the significance of celebrating Yoga by organizing an exclusive session for the faculty members to raise awareness about the numerous benefits of Yoga and its positive impact.
 UYIR Club Volunteers of SKCET along with Coimbatore City Police participated in the diwali traffic regulation at big bazaar street from 03.11.2023 to 10.11.2023. The volunteers educated the public by giving short messages on the benefits of wearing helmets ,seat belts and obeying traffic rules.
 Kovai fiesta 2023 is ideated, planned, and executed by the SKCET NSS Volunteers. The objective of this event is to provide a dynamic learning platform on marketing skills to students and cater an unforgettable shopping experience to its audience.
 National service scheme of SKCET has organized Medical camp at Attapadi Village, Coimbatore. Basic medical examinations were conducted to the beneficiaries at the venue.
 A rally on “Awareness about fitness “was organized by National service scheme of SKCET. NSS Volunteers inspired the public people by giving valuable messages about the importance of fitness in daily life
 SKCET has been awarded certificate of appreciation for taking part in “Drug free kovai” campaign organized by Coimbatore city police and park institutions.
